planes.name: Mental Plane
planes.zone: Top row of the Lo Shu Grid
planes.about: This plane describes your thinking pattern — how you plan, judge, decide, and turn an idea into a practical direction. A strong mental plane does not simply mean intelligence; it shows whether your mind naturally connects planning, confidence, and grounded judgement. A weak or missing pattern does not mean you cannot think well, but it usually means you need external structure, written planning, or better decision systems to avoid scattered or delayed choices.

2.label: grounded judgement
2.con: judgements made on emotion or urgency rather than ground facts
2.fix: pause before concluding and test decisions against facts and one trusted advisor

4.label: planning & structure
4.con: deciding first and structuring later, which can create avoidable reversals
4.fix: write the goal, risk, cost, and next three steps before every major choice

9.label: decisive action & confidence
9.con: hesitation at the exact moment a decision is needed
9.fix: practise small, quick decisions daily to rebuild decision confidence

planes.complete: Planning, confidence, and grounded judgement work together — this supports clear strategy, confident decisions, and the ability to explain your reasoning. A strong advisory and leadership mind. Guard against over-analysis; even the best mind must eventually decide.

planes.name: Emotional Plane
planes.zone: Middle row of the Lo Shu Grid
planes.about: This plane describes your emotional processing — how you feel, express, absorb, regulate, and set boundaries. It is not only about being emotional; it shows whether feelings become clear communication, stable self-understanding, and mature limits. A weaker pattern can still give warmth or sensitivity, but the person may need more deliberate reflection before reacting, sharing, or closing themselves off.

3.label: emotional expression & growth
3.con: appearing composed and controlled outside while feelings stay unexpressed — over time this can turn into distance or quiet resentment
3.fix: create a safe method of expression — honest conversations, writing, therapy-style reflection, or creative work

5.label: emotional grounding
5.con: emotions that swing before they settle, especially under pressure
5.fix: practise centring rituals — breathwork, journaling, or time near water

7.label: boundaries & refinement
7.con: porous boundaries — absorbing other people's moods and problems as your own
7.fix: define what you will and will not accept, and communicate it calmly and early

planes.complete: Feelings flow into words cleanly, you read others well, and relationships receive both warmth and mature limits. This is a strong pattern for partnerships, caregiving, public-facing work, and team harmony.

planes.name: Practical Plane
planes.zone: Bottom row of the Lo Shu Grid
planes.about: This plane describes your material execution — how you handle work, money, resources, delivery, and real-world results. A strong practical plane usually supports converting ability into visible outcomes. A weaker pattern does not mean failure; it means the person may need stronger systems, partners, deadlines, distribution habits, or financial discipline so effort does not remain incomplete or unmonetised.

1.label: drive & personal ownership
1.con: waiting for direction instead of owning outcomes end-to-end
1.fix: take single-point ownership of one outcome at a time

6.label: quality & refinement of output
6.con: rushed output that undersells your real ability
6.fix: define a finish standard before starting and deliver to it

8.label: responsibility & resource handling
8.con: effort that stays incomplete or unmonetised despite hard work
8.fix: build systems — budgets, checklists, deadlines — that carry work to completion

planes.complete: Resources, ownership, and execution quality work together — a strong pattern for business, career growth, property, operations, and money management. You naturally ask 'how will this actually work?' The area to manage is becoming too outcome-focused; do not let productivity dry out your inner life.

planes.name: Thought Plane
planes.zone: Left column of the Lo Shu Grid
planes.about: This plane describes long-form thinking — how you learn, analyse, connect ideas, and build understanding over time. It is different from quick intelligence. It shows whether your thoughts naturally become structured insight, deep study, and useful strategy. When this plane is weak, the person may still be smart, but thinking often improves when it is written down, discussed with the right people, and tested against real-world outcomes.

3.label: learning & knowledge growth
3.con: skill growth that plateaus because new inputs stop arriving
3.fix: schedule one new input every week — a book, course, or mentor conversation

4.label: idea generation
4.con: repeating known frames instead of questioning whether the strategy itself needs change
4.fix: capture ideas the moment they appear — a notes habit turns sparks into strategy

8.label: mental endurance & depth
8.con: giving up on hard problems just before the breakthrough
8.fix: schedule periodic zoom-outs: review assumptions and check that effort is going in the right direction

planes.complete: Ideas, learning, and depth reinforce each other — you can master complex subjects and convert study into strategy. This supports advisory roles, research, teaching, and any field where understanding compounds.

planes.name: Will Plane
planes.zone: Middle column of the Lo Shu Grid
planes.about: This plane describes willpower — how you push through resistance, stay steady under pressure, and adjust when circumstances change. It is not only about aggression or ambition; it shows whether your drive has stamina and flexibility. When this plane is weak, motivation may come in waves, so external accountability, public commitments, routines, and pressure-based deadlines become especially important.

1.label: self-belief & direction
1.con: drive that depends on others' approval or borrowed goals
1.fix: write your own direction down — self-chosen goals feed this plane

5.label: steadiness & adaptability
5.con: motivation that wavers whenever conditions change
5.fix: anchor yourself with fixed routines that hold you steady through change

9.label: drive & pushing power
9.con: strong intentions without force behind them when resistance appears
9.fix: use physical training, sport, or competition to build healthy pushing power

planes.complete: You can start with force, continue with patience, and change tactics when the situation demands — useful for entrepreneurship, sports, leadership, crisis work, and long projects. Strong will can also push past healthy limits; pair ambition with recovery and honest review points.

planes.name: Action Plane
planes.zone: Right column of the Lo Shu Grid
planes.about: This plane describes follow-through — how you take intention and convert it into disciplined, finished action. It shows patience, boundaries, standards, and the ability to complete work cleanly. A weaker action plane can create delay, overthinking, poor finish, or difficulty enforcing limits, even when the person has good ideas or strong desire. The solution is usually clearer rules, smaller deadlines, and a defined finish standard.

2.label: patience & grounding in action
2.con: over-editing, checking, or holding back instead of completing — hidden perfection does not produce results
2.fix: work to practical deadlines and minimum-viable standards — decide what is good enough for the current stage

6.label: finish quality
6.con: many things started, few cleanly finished
6.fix: define 'done' before you start, and close tasks fully before opening new ones

7.label: standards & limits
7.con: unclear limits, so work expands endlessly past its useful size
7.fix: set clear rules for when to stop refining and ship

planes.complete: Intentions reliably become finished work — patience, standards, and finish quality combine into a reputation for clean delivery. This supports operations, craftsmanship, and any role where the last 10% decides the value.

planes.name: Golden Rajyoga
planes.zone: Diagonal of the Lo Shu Grid (4 – 5 – 6)
planes.about: This diagonal is read as an opportunity-to-output pattern. It shows whether a person can notice openings, stabilise them into a workable structure, and refine them into something valuable. It is useful for business, career growth, freelancing, branding, sales, and opportunity conversion. It does not guarantee wealth by itself; it shows the natural support for converting chances into organised and presentable results.

4.label: spotting fresh opportunities
4.con: comfort with known formats while faster-moving openings pass unnoticed
4.fix: scan your market weekly — competitors, customer behaviour, new platforms, changing prices

5.label: structuring what you find
5.con: opportunities that stay informal and leak value before they crystallise
5.fix: give every opportunity a structure: owner, timeline, and budget

6.label: refining results into value
6.con: results delivered plain when they could be packaged premium
6.fix: polish before you present — packaging converts work into value

planes.complete: Opportunity spotting, structure, and refinement connect into a strong wealth-conversion pattern — business, sales, branding, and career growth all benefit directly. Once you identify the right opening, your ability to structure and refine converts it well.

planes.name: Silver Rajyoga
planes.zone: Diagonal of the Lo Shu Grid (8 – 5 – 2)
planes.about: This diagonal is read as a material-stability and asset-consolidation pattern. It is connected with property, savings, resource management, patience, and grounded progress. It does not mean instant money. It shows whether the person naturally understands holding, managing, protecting, and slowly building material security. When weak, property or asset growth may still happen, but it usually needs deliberate planning and disciplined external systems.

2.label: patience & continuity
2.con: becoming too controlling or pressure-driven when dealing with assets
2.fix: let assets mature — add patience, relationship sensitivity, and gradual planning instead of pressure

5.label: balanced management
5.con: money and resources handled reactively instead of on a rhythm
5.fix: review money and resources on a fixed monthly rhythm

8.label: asset & resource structure
8.con: assets held without structure, documentation, or protection
8.fix: formalise your assets — documentation, insurance, and clear ownership

planes.complete: Asset sense, balanced management, and patience combine into steady material security — property, savings, and long-term holdings grow well under your hand. This is the classic wealth-consolidation diagonal.

W.label: West (Saturn)

roomRules.doshText: Kitchen (fire) in {dir} creates a fire-element clash — linked to health issues and expenses.
roomRules.fix: Face east while cooking; place a yellow Jaisalmer stone slab or copper pyramid in the kitchen; keep a red/orange mat; if kitchen is in NE, add a small yellow bulb and sea-salt bowl.

roomRules.doshText: Master bedroom in {dir} disturbs stability and relationships (SW is the zone of rest).
roomRules.fix: Sleep with head towards south; use earthy tones (beige/brown); place a pair of rose-quartz stones; if bedroom is in SE, add a copper pyramid and avoid red; if in NW, add white/silver calming elements.

roomRules.doshText: Toilet in {dir} flushes away that zone's energy — a significant Vastu dosh.
roomRules.fix: Keep the door always closed; place a bowl of sea salt (change weekly); add a yellow bulb if in NE; place a brass pyramid on the outer wall; maintain strict dryness and ventilation; mirror on the outer door (not facing the seat) deflects energy.

roomRules.doshText: Pooja space in {dir} weakens spiritual protection of the home.
roomRules.fix: If relocation is impossible, face east or north while praying; keep the altar on the east wall; light a diya twice daily in the NE of the home regardless.

roomRules.doshText: Study room in {dir} works against concentration and memory retention.
roomRules.fix: Face east or north while studying; place the desk against a solid wall; keep a bookshelf in the west; use light yellow or green tones; keep a crystal or image that inspires focus on the desk.

roomRules.doshText: Staircase in {dir} (and especially in the centre/Brahmasthan) creates instability and drains energy.
roomRules.fix: Keep the staircase well-lit and clutter-free; avoid it rising directly toward the main door; place a heavy object or plant at its base; if central, a skylight or bright light above helps.

square.note: A square or rectangular plot with all corners intact is the most balanced and auspicious — energy flows evenly.

rectangular.note: A rectangular plot (longer north-south) is balanced; a slight east-north extension is auspicious for growth.

gomukhi.note: Gomukhi (narrow at the front, wide at the back) is auspicious for residence — it holds and gathers prosperity.

shermukhi.note: Shermukhi (wide at the front, narrow at the back) is generally avoided — energy and wealth are said to drain away. Remedy: strengthen the rear boundary with a wall or heavy planting.

missing-northeast.note: A cut/missing Northeast corner weakens the most sacred zone (Jupiter). Remedy: light a diya there daily, place a water feature, and keep it clean and bright.

missing-southwest.note: A missing Southwest corner destabilises the support zone (Rahu / master-bedroom area). Remedy: place heavy furniture or a brass pyramid to anchor the zone.

missing-southeast.note: A cut Southeast corner weakens the fire (kitchen) zone. Remedy: add a red/orange element and a copper pyramid.

missing-northwest.note: A cut Northwest corner weakens the movement/support zone (Moon). Remedy: add white/silver elements and a metal wind chime.

extended-northeast.note: An extension in the Northeast is highly auspicious — it strengthens prosperity, clarity and spiritual growth.

extended-southwest.note: An extension in the Southwest adds excessive heaviness. Remedy: keep it uncluttered and light, and use it for storage rather than living.

overshoot.en: Scattered focus, chatter and over-promising, nervous energy, too many deals, superficial connections.
overshoot.hi: बिखरा हुआ ध्यान, बहुत बोलना और वादों का बोझ, घबराहट भरी ऊर्जा, बहुत सारे सौदे, सतही रिश्ते।
overshoot.gu: છૂટાછવાયું ધ્યાન, વધુ બોલવું અને વચનોનો બોજ, ગભરાટ ભરી ઊર્જા, ઘણા સોદા, સપાટીપરી સંબંધો.

channel.en: Channel the speed into writing, trading, data or marketing; speak less and listen more; journal daily; donate green moong or stationery on Wednesday.
channel.hi: गति को लेखन, व्यापार, डेटा या मार्केटिंग में लगाएं; कम बोलें, ज़्यादा सुनें; रोज डायरी लिखें; बुधवार को हरा मूंग/स्टेशनरी दान करें।
channel.gu: ઝડપને લેખન, વેપાર, ડેટા કે માર્કેટિંગમાં લગાવો; ઓછું બોલો, વધુ સાંભળો; રોજ ડાયરી લખો; બુધવારે લીલા મગ/સ્ટેશનરી દાન કરો.

overshoot.en: Over-indulgence in luxury, spending, attraction or relationships, vanity, comfort-seeking.
overshoot.hi: विलासिता, खर्च, आकर्षण/रिश्तों में अति, दिखावा, आराम की तलाश की अधिकता।
overshoot.gu: વૈભવ, ખર્ચ, આકર્ષણ/સંબંધોમાં અતિ, દેખાડો, આરામની શોધ વધુ પડતી.

channel.en: Channel charm into art, hospitality or relationship counselling; enjoy beauty without excess — give white sweets or curd on Friday; make Friday a shared day of enjoyment.
channel.hi: आकर्षण को कला, आतिथ्य या रिश्तों की सलाह में लगाएं; सौंदर्य का आनंद संयम से लें — शुक्रवार को सफेद मिठाई/दही दान करें; शुक्रवार को साझा आनंद का दिन बनाएं।
channel.gu: આકર્ષણને કલા, આતિથ્ય કે સંબંધ-સલાહમાં લગાવો; સૌંદર્યનો આનંદ મર્યાદાથી લો — શુક્રવારે સફેદ મીઠાઈ/દહીં દાન કરો; શુક્રવારને સાઝો આનંદનો દિવસ બનાવો.

overshoot.en: Detachment and withdrawal, unexplained fears, isolation, sudden losses, escapism.
overshoot.hi: वैराग्य और एकांत, अज्ञात भय, अलगाव, अचानक हानि, पलायनवाद।
overshoot.gu: વૈરાગ્ય અને એકાંત, અજ્ઞાત ભય, અલગાવ, અચાનક હાનિ, પલાયનવાદ.

channel.en: Channel intuition into research, spirituality or healing; meditate 10 minutes daily; donate silently (stray dogs, blankets); stay connected to people.
channel.hi: अंतर्ज्ञान को शोध, अध्यात्म या चिकित्सा में लगाएं; रोज 10 मिनट ध्यान करें; बिना घोषणा दान करें (आवारा कुत्ते/कंबल); लोगों से जुड़े रहें।
channel.gu: અંતર્જ્ઞાનને સંશોધન, અધ્યાત્મ કે ચિકિત્સામાં લગાવો; રોજ 10 મિનિટ ધ્યાન કરો; જાહેરાત વગર દાન કરો (રખડતા કૂતરા/ધાબળા); લોકો સાથે જોડાયેલા રહો.

overshoot.en: Overwork and burnout, pessimism, delays and blame, controlling others, joint or bone strain.
overshoot.hi: अति परिश्रम और थकावट, निराशावाद, विलंब और दोषारोपण, दूसरों को नियंत्रित करना, जोड़ों/हड्डियों में खिंचाव।
overshoot.gu: વધુ પડતું કામ અને થાક, નિરાશાવાદ, વિલંબ અને દોષારોપણ, બીજાને નિયંત્રિત કરવું, સાંધા/હાડકાંની તાણ.

channel.en: Delegate Saturn's workload; serve workers and elders; donate oil, iron or black sesame on Saturday; take one rest day and structure work in cycles.
channel.hi: शनि का बोझ बांटें — काम सौंपें; मजदूरों/बड़ों की सेवा करें; शनिवार को तेल, लोहा या काले तिल दान करें; एक विश्राम दिवस रखें और काम को चक्रों में बांटें।
channel.gu: શનિનો બોજો વહેંચો — કામ સોંપો; મજૂરો/વડીલોની સેવા કરો; શનિવારે તેલ, લોખંડ કે કાળા તલ દાન કરો; એક વિશ્રાંતિ દિવસ રાખો અને કામને ચક્રોમાં વહેંચો.

overshoot.en: Anger, impulsive action, conflict, accidents, fiery arguments, a dominating force.
overshoot.hi: क्रोध, आवेशपूर्ण कार्य, संघर्ष, दुर्घटनाएं, तीखी बहस, दबदबे की शक्ति।
overshoot.gu: ક્રોધ, આવેશી કાર્ય, સંઘર્ષ, અકસ્માત, તીખી દલીલ, દબદબાની શક્તિ.

channel.en: Channel Mars into sport, exercise, martial arts or seva; count to ten before speaking; donate red lentils or red cloth on Tuesday; lead by protecting, not fighting.
channel.hi: मंगल को खेल, व्यायाम, मार्शल आर्ट या सेवा में लगाएं; बोलने से पहले दस तक गिनें; मंगलवार को मसूर की दाल/लाल कपड़ा दान करें; रक्षक बनकर नेतृत्व करें, लड़ाकू नहीं।
channel.gu: મંગળને રમત, કસરત, માર્શલ આર્ટ કે સેવામાં લગાવો; બોલતાં પહેલાં દસ સુધી ગણો; મંગળવારે મસૂર/લાલ કાપડ દાન કરો; લડાકુ નહીં, રક્ષક બનીને નેતૃત્વ કરો.

lesson.en: Life keeps removing shortcuts until work is finished fully and honestly. Half-done efforts, corner-cutting, procrastination and shifting blame return as repeated obstacles — steady, organised effort is the only way through.
lesson.hi: जीवन तब तक शॉर्टकट बंद करता रहता है जब तक काम पूरी निष्ठा से पूरा न हो। आधे-अधूरे प्रयास, कोना काटना, टालमटोल और दोष दूसरों पर डालना बार-बार बाधा बनकर लौटते हैं — व्यवस्थित और निरंतर परिश्रम ही एकमात्र मार्ग है।
lesson.gu: જીવન ત્યાં સુધી શોર્ટકટ બંધ કરતું રહે છે જ્યાં સુધી કામ પૂરી નિષ્ઠાથી પૂરું ન થાય. અધૂરા પ્રયાસ, છેડા કાપવા, ટાળવણું અને દોષ બીજા પર નાખવો વારંવાર અવરોધ બનીને પાછા આવે છે — વ્યવસ્થિત અને સતત પરિશ્રમ જ એકમાત્ર માર્ગ છે.

remedy.en: On Saturdays serve or feed daily-wage workers; keep one fixed daily work-slot that nothing can break; finish one pending task fully before starting anything new (Rahu–4 discipline).
remedy.hi: शनिवार को दिहाड़ी मजदूरों की सेवा करें या उन्हें भोजन दें; रोज का एक निश्चित काम-समय रखें जिसे कुछ भी न तोड़ सके; नया काम शुरू करने से पहले एक अटका हुआ काम पूरा करें (राहु–४ का अनुशासन)।
remedy.gu: શનિવારે મજૂરોની સેવા કરો કે ભોજન આપો; રોજનો એક નિશ્ચિત કામનો સમય રાખો જેને કંઈ પણ તોડી ન શકે; નવું કામ શરૂ કરતાં પહેલાં એક અટકેલું કામ પૂરું કરો (રાહુ–૪ ની શિસ્ત).

lesson.en: The senses keep pulling toward excess — food, drink, comfort, thrill-seeking or promises made lightly and broken easily. The lesson is moderation: freedom survives only inside commitment.
lesson.hi: इंद्रियां बार-बार अति की ओर खींचती हैं — भोजन, आराम, उत्साह के पीछे भागना या हल्के में दिए और आसानी से टूटते वादे। सीख है संयम — स्वतंत्रता केवल प्रतिबद्धता के भीतर ही टिकती है।
lesson.gu: ઇન્દ્રિયો વારંવાર અતિ તરફ ખેંચે છે — ભોજન, આરામ, ઉત્તેજનાની લય, કે હળવાશથી આપીને સહેલાશથી તૂટી જતાં વચનો. સીખ છે સંયમ — સ્વાતંત્ર્ય ફક્ત પ્રતિબદ્ધતામાં જ ટકે છે.

remedy.en: Keep five small, unbreakable promises instead of one big one; avoid speculation and impulse spending; donate green moong or books/stationery on Wednesday; one evening a week, keep the senses light.
remedy.hi: एक बड़े वादे की जगह पाँच छोटे, अटूट वादे रखें; सट्टे और आवेगी खर्च से बचें; बुधवार को हरा मूंग या पुस्तकें/स्टेशनरी दान करें; सप्ताह में एक शाम इंद्रियों को हल्की रखें।
remedy.gu: એક મોટા વચનને બદલે પાંચ નાના, અકાપત વચનો રાખો; સટ્ટા અને આવેગી ખર્ચથી બચો; બુધવારે લીલા મગ કે પુસ્તકો/સ્ટેશનરી દાન કરો; અઠવાડિયામાં એક સાંજ ઇન્દ્રિયો માટે હળવી રાખો.

lesson.en: Sudden falls arrive where pride or secrecy built the tower — often around love, trust or status. What collapses was standing on ego; what is rebuilt on humility and truth stays standing.
lesson.hi: जहां मीनार अहंकार या गोपनीयता पर खड़ी होती है, वहां अचानक पतन आता है — प्रायः प्रेम, विश्वास या प्रतिष्ठा के क्षेत्र में। जो गिरता है वो अहं पर टिका था; जो विनम्रता और सत्य पर फिर बनता है, वही टिकता है।
lesson.gu: જ્યાં મિનારો અહંકાર કે ગોપનીયતા પર ઊભો હોય ત્યાં અચાનક પતન આવે છે — સામાન્ય રીતે પ્રેમ, વિશ્વાસ કે પ્રતિષ્ઠામાં. જે પડે છે તે અહં પર ટકેલું હતું; જે વિનમ્રતા અને સત્ય પર ફરી બને છે તે જ ટકે છે.

remedy.en: Practise silent charity — feed stray dogs or donate blankets without telling anyone; meditate 10 minutes daily (Ketu–7); be the first to apologise in your closest relationship; never attack anyone's dignity publicly.
remedy.hi: मौन दान का अभ्यास करें — आवारा कुत्तों को खिलाएं या कंबल बिना किसी को बताए दान करें; रोज १० मिनट ध्यान करें (केतु–७); सबसे निकट के रिश्ते में क्षमा मांगने की पहल करें; किसी की प्रतिष्ठा सार्वजनिक रूप से कभी न ठेस पहुंचाएं।
remedy.gu: મૌન દાનનો અભ્યાસ કરો — રખડતા કૂતરાઓને ખવડાવો કે કોઈને ન કહેતા ધાબળા દાન કરો; રોજ ૧૦ મિનિટ ધ્યાન કરો (કેતુ–૭); સૌથી નજીકના સંબંધમાં ક્ષમા માંગવાની પહેલ કરો; કોઈની પ્રતિષ્ઠાને જાહેરમાં ક્યારેય ઠેસ ન પહોંચાડો.

lesson.en: Independence was once misused — either leaning on no one and refusing help, or making others carry too much. Life re-teaches fair self-reliance: stand alone when needed, accept help with grace, and use strength for others.
lesson.hi: स्वतंत्रता का दुरुपयोग हुआ — या तो किसी पर भरोसा न करना और सहायता ठुकराना, या दूसरों पर अति बोझ डालना। जीवन निष्पक्ष आत्मनिर्भरता फिर सिखाता है — ज़रूरत हो तो अकेले खड़े रहें, सहायता शालीनता से स्वीकारें, बल दूसरों के लिए लगाएं।
lesson.gu: સ્વતંત્રતાનો દુરુપયોગ થયો — કાં તો કોઈ પર આધાર ન લેવો અને મદદ અસ્વીકારવી, કે બીજા પર અતિશય બોજ નાખવો. જીવન ન્યાયસંગત આત્મનિર્ભરતા ફરી શીખવે છે — જરૂર હોય તો એકલા ઊભા રહો, મદદ સૌજન્યથી સ્વીકારો, શક્તિ બીજા માટે વાપરો.

remedy.en: Offer water to the rising Sun daily (Surya arghya); serve your father or a mentor; once a week do one task for someone without being asked; donate wheat, jaggery or copper on Sunday.
remedy.hi: रोज उगते सूर्य को जल अर्पित करें (सूर्य अर्घ्य); पिता या गुरु की सेवा करें; हर हफ्ते किसी के लिए बिना कहे एक काम करें; रविवार को गेहूं, गुड़ या तांबा दान करें।
remedy.gu: રોજ ઊગતા સૂર્યને જળ અર્પણ કરો (સૂર્ય અર્ઘ્ય); પિતા કે ગુરુની સેવા કરો; દર અઠવાડિયે કોઈ માટે વગર કહ્યે એક કામ કરો; રવિવારે ઘઉં, ગોળ કે તાંબું દાન કરો.

theme.en: Independence and self-starting — a phase to lead, launch and build identity.
theme.hi: स्वतंत्रता और आत्म-शुरुआत — नेतृत्व, शुभारंभ और पहचान बनाने का चरण।
theme.gu: સ્વતંત્રતા અને સ્વ-શરૂઆત — નેતૃત્વ, શરૂઆત અને ઓળખ ઘડવાનો તબક્કો.

theme.en: Partnership and patience — alliances, diplomacy and quiet consolidation.
theme.hi: साझेदारी और धैर्य — गठबंधन, कूटनीति और शांत सुधृढ़ीकरण।
theme.gu: ભાગીદારી અને ધીરજ — જોડાણ, કૂટનીતિ અને શાંત મજબૂતાઈ.

theme.en: Expression and expansion — visibility, creativity, teaching and growth.
theme.hi: अभिव्यक्ति और विस्तार — प्रमुखता, रचनात्मकता, शिक्षण और वृद्धि।
theme.gu: અભિવ્યક્તિ અને વિસ્તાર — દેખાવ, સર્જનાત્મકતા, શિક્ષણ અને વૃદ્ધિ.

theme.en: Foundation and system — hard structuring; slow but permanent gains.
theme.hi: नींव और व्यवस्था — कठोर संरचना; धीमे पर स्थायी लाभ।
theme.gu: પાયો અને વ્યવસ્થા — મક્કમ બાંધકામ; ધીમો પરંતુ કાયમી લાભ.

theme.en: Change and commerce — travel, deals, reinvention; doors move fast.
theme.hi: परिवर्तन और व्यापार — यात्रा, सौदे, नवीनीकरण; दरवाज़े तेज़ी से खुलते हैं।
theme.gu: ફેરફાર અને વેપાર — મુસાફરી, સોદા, નવીનીકરણ; દરવાજા ઝડપથી ખુલે છે.

theme.en: Home, harmony and service — family duty, comfort and trusted counsel.
theme.hi: घर, सामंजस्य और सेवा — पारिवारिक दायित्व, सुख-सुविधा और विश्वसनीय सलाह।
theme.gu: ઘર, સુમેળ અને સેવા — પારિવારિક ફરજ, આરામ અને વિશ્વસનીય સલાહ.

theme.en: Depth and mastery — study, specialisation, spiritual insight; inward strength.
theme.hi: गहराई और प्रवीणता — अध्ययन, विशेषज्ञता, आध्यात्मिक अंतर्दृष्टि; आंतरिक बल।
theme.gu: ઊંડાણ અને નિપુણતા — અભ્યાસ, વિશિષ્ટતા, આધ્યાત્મિક સૂઝ; આંતરિક બળ.

theme.en: Authority and harvest — karma pays; command, management, material results.
theme.hi: अधिकार और फसल — कर्म फल देता है; कमान, प्रबंधन, भौतिक परिणाम।
theme.gu: સત્તા અને કાપણી — કર્મ ફળ આપે છે; કમાન, સંચાલન, ભૌતિક પરિણામ.

theme.en: Action and completion — bold closures, courage and large-scale service.
theme.hi: कर्म और पूर्णता — साहसिक समापन, धैर्य और बड़े पैमाने की सेवा।
theme.gu: ક્રિયા અને સંપૂર્ણતા — હિંમતભર્યું સમાપન, સાહસ અને મોટા પાયે સેવા.

0.en: The challenge of choice — no single fault is assigned; any number's weakness can surface. Discipline across the board is the answer.
0.hi: चुनाव की चुनौती — कोई एक दोष निर्धारित नहीं; किसी भी अंक की कमजोरी उभर सकती है। सभी क्षेत्रों में अनुशासन ही उत्तर है।
0.gu: પસંદગીનો પડકાર — કોઈ એક ખામી નિયત નથી; કોઈ પણ અંકની નબળાઈ ઊભરી શકે છે. સર્વક્ષેત્ર શિસ્ત જ ઉત્તર છે.

1.en: Stand up for yourself — overcome the urge to yield to others' will.
1.hi: अपने लिए खड़े होना सीखें — दूसरों की इच्छा के आगे झुकने की प्रवृत्ति पर काबू पाएं।
1.gu: પોતાના માટે ઊભા રહેતા શીખો — બીજાની ઇચ્છા આગળ નમવાની વૃત્તિ પર કાબૂ મેળવો.

2.en: Over-sensitivity and self-doubt — build inner security without comparing yourself to others.
2.hi: अति-संवेदनशीलता और आत्म-संदेह — बिना तुलना के आंतरिक सुरक्षा बनाएं।
2.gu: અતિ-સંવેદનશીલતા અને આત્મ-શંકા — સરખામણી વગર આંતરિક સુરક્ષા ઘડો.

3.en: Scattered self-expression — focus your words; finish what you start saying and doing.
3.hi: बिखरी अभिव्यक्ति — अपने शब्दों पर केंद्रित रहें; जो कहना-करना शुरू करें, उसे पूरा करें।
3.gu: છૂટાછવાયેલી અભિવ્યક્તિ — તમારા શબ્દો પર કેન્દ્રિત રહો; શરૂ કરેલું કહેવું-કરવું પૂરું કરો.

4.en: Rigidity or disorder — build routines and honour them without becoming inflexible.
4.hi: कठोरता या अस्तव्यस्तता — दिनचर्या बनाएं और ढीले हुए बिना उसका पालन करें।
4.gu: કઠોરતા કે ગડબડ — દિનચર્યા બનાવો અને અનમ્ય ન બનતા તેનું પાલન કરો.

5.en: Restlessness — channel freedom constructively; don't run from responsibility.
5.hi: बेचैनी — स्वतंत्रता को रचनात्मक दिशा दें; जिम्मेदारी से न भागें।
5.gu: અસ્થિરતા — સ્વાતંત્ર્યને રચનાત્મક દિશા આપો; જવાબદારીથી ભાગશો નહીં.

6.en: Perfectionism in relationships — accept loved ones as they are; duty without resentment.
6.hi: रिश्तों में परफेक्शनवाद — अपनों को जैसे हैं स्वीकारें; कर्तव्य, बिना शिकायत।
6.gu: સંબંધોમાં સંપૂર્ણતાવાદ — પ્રિયજનોને જેમ છે તેમ સ્વીકારો; ફરજ, ફરિયાદ વગર.

7.en: Trust and faith — fear of betrayal closes you off; develop discernment without suspicion.
7.hi: विश्वास और आस्था — धोखे के डर से बंद न हों; संदेह के बिना विवेक विकसित करें।
7.gu: વિશ્વાસ અને શ્રદ્ધા — છેતરાવાના ડરથી બંધાશો નહીં; શંકા વગર વિવેક વિકસાવો.

8.en: Money and power lessons — balance material drive with ethics; neither chase it nor scorn it.
8.hi: धन और सत्ता की सीख — भौतिक महत्वाकांक्षा को नैतिकता से संतुलित करें; न पीछा करें, न तिरस्कार।
8.gu: ધન અને સત્તાની સીખ — ભૌતિક મહત્વાકાંક્ષાને નૈતિકતા સાથે સંતુલિત કરો; ન પાછળ ભાગો, ન તિરસ્કાર કરો.
